$description: The one file that defines a brand. Everything else in Keel is shared. To rebrand: copy this file, change the values, point scripts/brand.mjs at it (BRAND=yourbrand), run `npm run tokens`. See docs/brand.md.
name: Keel

logo.$description: Reserved for the app shell (Day 24). wordmark is used until an image is provided; src is a path under public/.

accent.$description: The action color: buttons, links, focus, selection. Give a hue (0-360, OKLCH) or a seed hex like "#105FD9". Lightness is adjusted automatically so white text on the button passes WCAG AA.

neutral.$description: Grays for text, surfaces and borders. hue sets the tint direction (255 cool, 70 warm); tint is none, subtle or strong.

font.$description: Interface typeface. Install its package and import it at the top of src/index.css.

radius.$description: Corner style: sharp (half), default, or rounded (1.5x). Pills and avatars stay fully round.
